Q6097.reason: Modern statutes in most states convert a fee tail to a fee simple absolute, so the grantor keeps no reversion and has nothing left for the niece to take.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on x-rays and data that experts in the field reasonably rely on, even when those x-rays are not in evidence.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into a hotel guest's room, a dwelling, at night with intent to commit a felony (threatening extortion) at entry is burglary; the other options lack a breaking, a dwelling, nighttime, or intent at entry.
